items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah the Wolf and then Gretney. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah they up in Gretney.

ctx.x: Do you remember any other clubs over in there? Well all the clubs that I knew over there was the Elks and I knew the Young Men's of Algea, the Young Men's of McDonaville and they have the Wolf.
Yeah the Wolf and then Gretney.
Yeah they up in Gretney. No, I don't know any other clubs that organized over the river. Nothing no more in the Masonic.
